entries.f14259b1a74b64c0: This business sells condominiums and detached houses to individual customers, and sells rental housing, office buildings and other properties to investors. Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. itself sells business facilities and other properties; Mitsui Fudosan Residential Co., Ltd. sells detached houses and mid- and high-rise residential buildings and other properties; and TID PTE.LTD., MITSUI FUDOSAN AMERICA, INC. and MITSUI FUDOSAN (U.K.) LTD. conduct property sales businesses in Singapore, the United States and the United Kingdom. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥729,271 million, and segment profit (business profit) was ¥193,182 million, the largest profit of the five segments.
entries.f64f7e4fe3d7b905: Under the Mitsui reorganization plan of the Mitsui Somotokata, Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. was established on July 15, 1941 with capital of ¥3 million, with the main purpose of managing the real estate owned by the former Mitsui Gomei Kaisha. Since its founding, the leasing and management of office buildings and the like had been the core of its business.
entries.fd57f2a65e449a45: This was the year in which a way of earning called "sale" — not leasing buildings to obtain rent, but selling what was created and receiving the price — was added.
